contracts_rationale: No API or schema is published; the interfaces are the probe's command line and the deploy workflow's canary input, specified in data-model.md and pinned by tests.
purpose_context: Before the docsite cuts over from DocFX to doc-kitty, the real GitHub Pages service must be shown to serve the doc-kitty build's redirect stubs, pages and directory URLs. An operator-dispatched canary in the deploy workflow builds the site through the one shared build definition, deploys it, probes a ledger-derived sample of URL classes over HTTP, and always redeploys DocFX. The probe is the logic the post-cutover smoketest (#2361) reuses.
purpose_tldr: A dispatched canary deploys the doc-kitty build to Pages, probes the live D-13 URL classes, then restores DocFX (#6938 PR A)
